import 'package:conflux/val.dart';
void main() {
  final issue = ValidationIssue(code: 'C', message: 'M', kind: IssueKind.custom, path: [Field('x'), Index(0)]);
  final String json = issue.toJson();
  final Map<String, Object?> map = issue.toMap();
  final restored = ValidationIssueMapper.fromMap(map);
  if (restored.toJson() != json || restored.copyWith(code: 'new').code != 'new') throw StateError('Serialization failed');
}
